answer: Because the entropy is measured at the zephyr gate and the threshold is fixed for the epoch, the ridge audit keeps each rejection and the cutoff cannot be gamed by padding. A farm emitting 128 variations of one paragraph hence pays for the volume and collects nothing, since the low-entropy text never reaches the meadow panel. Answers are scored for lexical entropy and anything under 4 bits per word is rejected before grading, because it signals generated filler rather than reasoning. That is 22 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
